sections.text: We will evaluate the accessible wastewater and identify material that blocks inspection near the repaired line. Loose debris and attached insulation require separate handling decisions. The removal scope will describe what needs to leave before retained surfaces can be reached.

sections.title: Inspect contact areas after clearing
sections.text: Debris may conceal exposure against wood or another component rather than only water on the ground. We will review the surfaces made visible and explain their treatment needs. Clearing the loose material will not be represented as resolving the condition beneath it.

sections.title: Clean and dry suitable retained components
sections.text: We will identify surfaces appropriate to keep and explain the cleaning work, followed by related moisture treatment where needed. Deteriorated structural material requires a separate repair decision. Extracting wastewater does not establish that every exposed component is ready for new insulation.

sections.title: Prepare the underside for replacement materials
sections.text: We will record completed sections and remaining source or access issues. The plumbing repair and surrounding restoration retain separate statuses. Reinsulation should follow the treated-surface condition so it does not cover a contact area still awaiting work.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/farmersville.estimate: Clearance, affected material quantity, wastewater spread, and disposal needs shape the estimate. Share the plumbing findings and observations already available without entering the affected space.
